priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Restore listener removal in the cleanup callback
findings.body: When a caller invokes the returned cleanup while the socket remains alive, the handler stays registered and continues receiving messages. Repeated attach/cleanup cycles accumulate retained handlers, causing duplicate processing, memory growth, and listener-limit warnings.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts:3 returns an empty cleanup callback, while the base implementation called socket.off("message", handler). The registered handler therefore remains attached after cleanup and the prior defect is unchanged.
